text: 经营贷利率悄然上行！银行主动缩规模，贸易类申请人被收紧 知情人士对记者表示，未来或逐步升至3%以上。
text_en: Business loan rates are quietly rising! Banks take the initiative to shrink scale, and trade-related applicants are being tightened. A person familiar with the matter told reporters that rates may gradually rise above 3% in the future.
